'''Doaba Guerfel''', originally known as '''Nomad's Retreat''', was a [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[Nomad Mountains]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Description==
Cradled in the arms of Corellia's northern Nomad Mountains, Doaba Guerfel was a quaint mountain resort with a slow pace and peaceful history. The city was known as Corellia's finest mountain resort city. Like many other tourist destinations, Doaba Guerfel strived to remain a placid, safe escape from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG:DG" />

Due to the city's proximity to pristine forests and wilderness, the citizens of Doaba Guerfel were active environmentalists. The town spent millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each year on preservation and restoration projects in the hopes of protecting Corellia's native flora and fauna, but perhaps more significant was Doaba Guerfel's reputation for wild revelry. Nights in Doaba Guerfel were filled with sounds of music and celebration, and the town annually consumed more [[Corellian ale/Legends|Corellian ale]] than all of the neighboring cities combined.<ref name="SWG:DG" />

==History==
The site was originally a private resort, complete with a hunting lodge, small [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], and raucous [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. The limited membership included Corellia's wealthiest families, as well as many powerful [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]]. The resort, which was simply known as Nomad's Retreat, eventually fell under sharp criticism for it elitism. Over the course of several decades, Nomad's Retreat gradually expanded its membership and eventually became a public resort about four hundred years before the start of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DG" />

For nearly a century, Nomad's Retreat was a seasonal resort town, with attendance ebbing and flowing as weather changed. To provide staff with semi-permanent homes, the proprietors and investors of the retreat funded construction of a village only a few [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the resort. The village, which took on the name Doaba Guerfel, was populated for only about half of each [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard year]] with a variety of resort staff, ranging from cooks and cleaning crew to hunting guides and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. During the next three hundred years, Doaba Guerfel continued to grow, eventually merging with the original resort and Nomad's Retreat no longer existed as an independent entity.<ref name="SWG:DG" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the city was far removed from galactic politics and had rigorously resisted both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] incursions.<ref name="SWG:DG" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]] was very active in Doaba Guerfel.<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: The Unlucky Mayor|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the city hosted a large [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration.<ref name="SWG:WLD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Wookiee Life Day}}</ref>

==Inhabitants==
The following individuals were residents or visitors of the city in the time after the Battle of Yavin: [[Coraline Dynes]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Jadam Questrel]], [[Scolex Grath]], [[Zakarisz Ghent]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Willham Burke]],<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> [[Talte]], [[Vitala Baize]], [[Lilith Laughlin]], [[Dayana]], [[Gwhirrye Baric]], [[Xyrias Undea]], [[Trins Evnar]], [[Seyda Shae]], [[Genovin Jasha]], [[Jade McDonagh]], [[Kazic Pendre]],<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> and [[Strilath Farles]].<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Doaba Guerfel appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

From [[December 16]], [[2008]] to [[January 12]], [[2009]], Doaba Guerfel was one of three cities chosen to be the hosts of the live [[W:c:swg:Life Day|Wookiee Life Day event]].<ref name="SWG:C11.4">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68152&month=122008|text=Chapter 11.4: The Battle of Echo Base}}</ref><ref name="SWG:WLD" /> During the event, the entire city and its surroundings were covered with white snow as a constant snowfall occurred.<ref name="SWG:WLD" /> After many players asked to keep the snow in Doaba Guerfel after the end of the regular Life Day events, the developers decided to make the weather change permanent.<ref name="SWG:GU6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68180&month=012009|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 6}}</ref> Doaba Guerfel also continued being the host of festivities during subsequent Life Day events.<ref name="SonyCite-''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Wookiee Life Day — On Tuesday, December 15th">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68556&month=122009|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Wookiee Life Day &mdash; On Tuesday, December 15th}}</ref><ref name="SWG:GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 19 &mdash; Tuesday, December 14, 2010}}</ref>
